title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-003
doc_notes: This document consists of internal FAA correspondence, memoranda, and news clippings regarding the investigation of the JAL 1628 UFO incident and the subsequent unauthorized release of investigative materials.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines flight 1628 crew reported sighting unidentified objects over Alaska while en route to Anchorage.
incidents.explanation: FAA investigation suggested the sightings were likely caused by moonlight reflecting off ice crystals and the planet Jupiter.
incidents.quote: It was not a weather phenomena. Not a star. It moved with you.

incidents.summary: Captain Terauchi reported spotting unusual lights while on a flight from Paris to Anchorage.
incidents.explanation: Agreed by pilot and FAA to be village lights diffused by ice crystals.
incidents.quote: We see irregular pulsating lights just there is a large black chunk just in front of us.

incidents.summary: Air Force crew and Alaskan Airlines flight crew reported sighting unidentified air traffic.
